p: Rayners Lane grew up in the 1930s Metroland boom, and the parade of shops where you'll find MERKUR is classic interwar suburbia. Rayners Lane station, served by the Metropolitan and Piccadilly lines, is a fine Art Deco building, and it's only a short walk away. MERKUR is 18+, adults only.

If you've time for a wander, Pinner village, with its old timber-framed buildings and High Street pubs, is a short hop north. Headstone Manor & Museum in Harrow, a moated manor house with exhibitions on local history, is another nearby option.
